alt: The cardiac cycle drawn as a clockwise loop of five labelled steps, each with a small heart diagram showing which chambers are contracting and which way blood is moving: atrial contraction, isovolumic contraction, ventricular ejection, isovolumic relaxation, and ventricular filling. An inner ring marks which portion is atrial systole and which is atrial diastole; a shaded wedge marks ventricular systole. Three small ECG traces around the edge highlight the P wave, the QRS complex, and the T wave against the matching step.
